## Class Activity Part I

We are going to practice tidying data and creating graphics.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Utilize This Code with a Partner

1.  Tidy `south` so you can make a bar graph showing demographic breakdown by state

```{r eval = FALSE}
south <- tibble(
  state = c("NC", "SC", "GA", "TN"),
  pct_black = c(.2, .3, .4, .25),
  pct_hisp = c(.1, .2, .2, .15),
  pct_asian = c(.1, .2, .1, .1),
  pct_white = c(.6, .3, .3, .5)
)

```

1.  Tidy `relig_income`

```{r}
relig_income
```

1.  Tidy `us_rent_income` (hint: names_from or values_from can be a list; use c())

```{r}
us_rent_income
```
